title: Everything in Fortnitemares Right Now
caption:
#EpicPartner Everything in Fortnitemares right now: bosses, the Dark Cartridge, Safety in Numbers and more. Use code BAD in the Item Shop.
#Fortnite #Fortnitemares

lines.text: A cursed cartridge is spreading through the Island, corrupting everything it touches.
Step into Battle Royale to see what hair-raising horrors await,
including powerful new weapons, terrifying mechanics, horrifying bosses, and more!

with one always lurking at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Parlor.
